source.title: How to channel Cortis's Y2K thrift store style
source.author: Vogue Singapore

tips.text: Build Y2K streetwear from thrifted and vintage pieces so the outfit looks like your own wardrobe, not a copied mood board.
tips.why: Clothes that seem collected over time look personal.

tips.text: For a vintage athletic look, use old-school sportswear such as track jackets, windbreakers and hoodies.
tips.why: Retro sportswear gives an energetic, relaxed feel.

tips.text: Let one strong piece carry the outfit and keep the rest simple.
tips.why: A single focus stops a bold look from turning busy.

tips.text: When the setting is already loud, rely on texture and layering rather than loud pieces.
tips.why: Texture adds interest while keeping the look grounded.

tips.text: For everyday Y2K style, wear a graphic tee with straight-leg or bootcut jeans and worn-in sneakers.
tips.why: It is the simplest version of the vintage look.

tips.text: Treat rings and belts as accents, not the main statement.
tips.why: Small accessories should support the outfit, not compete with it.

outfits.outfit: track-jacket red vintage +sportswear, tshirt black streetwear +graphic, track-pants navy sporty +stripes
outfits.why: A vintage track jacket over a graphic tee with striped track pants gives a retro athletic look.
